name: Vizier of Many Faces
clause: You may have ~ enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except if ~ was embalmed, the token has no mana cost, it's white, and it's a Zombie in addition to its other types.

needs.proposedSignature: Add to COVER_RULES.asEnters the anchored shape /^(?:you may have )?~ enters? (?:the battlefield )?as a copy of (.+?)(?:, except (.+?))?\.?$/ whose `value` check requires an asEnters entry of kind 'enter-as-copy' with the matching `optional` flag, so `covers: [{ line, by: 'asEnters' }]` can claim a clone line.
needs.semantics: enter-as-copy is a replacement effect, so it is not an ability and no ability may legitimately claim its printed line; and COVER_RULES.asEnters lists only the tapped / pay-life / counters / choose / discard-or-graveyard shapes, so no covers entry can claim it either. Every clone card whose printed clause the copy-clone parser rule declines (any 'except …' it cannot read — Vizier of Many Faces' 'except if ~ was embalmed …') is therefore permanently unfinishable however good its script is: the declaration gives real behaviour but claims nothing.
needs.clause: You may have ~ enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except if ~ was embalmed, the token has no mana cost, it's white, and it's a Zombie in addition to its other types.

needs.proposedSignature: Face declaration `embalm?: { cost: ManaCost }` (shaped like `cycling`) + covers[].by kind 'embalm' anchored /^embalm (\{.+\})$/ requiring embalm.cost.raw to equal the printed cost, plus `CopyException.noManaCost?: true`, plus a KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS entry: embalm: '{cost}, exile ~ from your graveyard: create a token that's a copy of ~, except it's a white Zombie with no mana cost. activate only as a sorcery'. (Eternalize is the same shape with a 4/4 black exception.)
needs.semantics: The BEHAVIOUR of embalm is already writable — an activated ability with fromGraveyard: true, sorcerySpeed: true, cost { mana, exileSelfFromGraveyard: true } and copy-permanent target 'self' except { colors: ['W'], addSubtypes: ['Zombie'] } — and that is what the script written here does. Two things block it from ever being VERIFIED: the printed declaration line 'Embalm {3}{U}{U}' has no entry in KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS, so the round trip scores it 0 as a renderer gap and the card score (a minimum over lines) is 0; and CopyException cannot say 'has no mana cost'.
